body:
Track 11 milestone 1 (`mimic-contexts`): RAID suite (8 families, 300 human + 300 plain-prompt chat-LLM texts each, split by family) and prompt-free reference detectors. Held-out-family AUROC: n-gram LR 0.93, Binoculars-style 0.80, perplexity 0.76, length-only 0.52 (chance). Verified locally: 10 unit tests pass, `site/build.py` prints ok (422 projects), after merging main. No CI workflow covers this path. Preliminary; the imitator is RAID's own generations, not a prompted one (stated in README).
